title: Create an API token
description: Creates a credential acting as the user.

title: Run an automation rule
description: Triggers a rule, which can edit issues and send messages.

title: List project components
description: Lists project components, page by page.

title: Search project components
description: Searches project components by a query.

title: Update a project component
description: Changes fields of a project component.

title: Export issues
description: Exports issues to CSV or XML.

title: List custom fields
description: Lists custom fields, page by page.

title: Update a custom field
description: Changes fields of a custom field.

title: Add a user to a group
description: Adds a member, who inherits the group permissions.

title: Revoke a user from a group
description: Takes a member out of a group.

title: Assign an issue
description: Sets the assignee, who may be notified.

title: Attach a file to an issue
description: Uploads a file visible to everyone who can see the issue.

title: Edit many issues
description: Applies one change to many issues.

title: Move an issue to another project
description: Changes the project and key of an issue.

title: Change issue security level
description: Changes who can see an issue.

title: Transition an issue
description: Moves an issue through its workflow; post functions may run.

title: Grant a permission in a scheme
Revoke a permission in a scheme
Assign a permission scheme
description: Changes the permissions of a project.

title: Set project role members
description: Changes who has a role in a project.

title: Complete a sprint
description: Closes a sprint and moves unfinished issues.

title: List project versions
description: Lists project versions, page by page.

title: Search project versions
description: Searches project versions by a query.

title: Update a project version
description: Changes fields of a project version.

title: Publish a workflow draft
description: Applies workflow changes to all issues using it.
